mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has risen every week from 2.9 to 5.1, a persistent shift of time back into the home; this at-home stickiness removes weekday and weekend shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC keeps falling over the next four weeks.
regime_hint: stay-at-home drift (residential mobility rising four consecutive weeks)
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is at or above the last-28-day mean of -15.8 while RESIDENTIAL continues to rise week over week.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT broke its three-week plateau near -22.0 and printed -24.0 at t-0w; a transit threshold breach of this size signals cancellation of discretionary trips, which pulls RETAIL_REC lower within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean falls below -23.0 percent (observed -24.0 at t-0w after -22.0 at t-1w)
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved -22.9, -22.1, -22.0, -24.0 across the four weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the two weeks following any TRANSIT weekly print below -23.0 percent.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES improved 4.9 points to -18.4 while RESIDENTIAL rose 2.2 points over the same four weeks; commuting gains are offset by more home-based time, and the net out-of-home demand loss lowers RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises in the same week that RESIDENTIAL also rises
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -23.3 to -18.4 while RESIDENTIAL rose from 2.9 to 5.1
regime_hint: partial reopening with residual home-based work
failure_condition: In weeks where WORKPLACES rises and RESIDENTIAL rises together, the RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean exceeds the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS collapsed 22.1 points from 35.0 to 12.9 over three weeks, removing the outdoor trips that chain into nearby shops; the retail drag persists for two weeks and holds RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 15 points within a three-week window
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from 35.0 at t-3w to 12.9 at t-0w
regime_hint: outdoor-activity contraction (seasonal decline in park visitation)
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks after any three-week PARKS fall larger than 15 points.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM stabilized near -7 after recovering from -9.6, showing households have locked into essential-trip routines; consolidation of errands into grocery trips crowds out separate retail-and-recreation visits within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM four-week range stays under 4 points around its mean
regime_hint: essential-trip consolidation (grocery flat within 4 points over four weeks)
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the week following any four-week GROCERY_PHARM range below 4 points.

mechanism_narrative: The 22.1-point PARKS decline over three weeks marks the seasonal shift of leisure spending indoors; displaced outdoor demand reallocates to indoor retail-and-recreation venues, lifting RETAIL_REC above its last-28-day mean within four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS dropped 22.1 points while RETAIL_REC dropped 3.0 points over the same four weeks
failure_condition: After a three-week PARKS decline greater than 15 points, the RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is equal to or below the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC fell three consecutive weeks to -17.7, the deepest print in the window and 3.0 points below t-3w; this saturating down-move exhausts the deterioration and the next four weeks mean-revert upward.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC three-week cumulative change is -3.0 points or worse
regime_hint: sharp deceleration regime (three-week cumulative retail decline at or beyond -3.0 points)
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean stays at or below -15.8 after a three-week cumulative decline of 3.0 points or more.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, transit capacity cuts plus the WORKPLACES-versus-TRANSIT divergence push discretionary trips down; retail-and-recreation follows transit with a two-week lag and falls below its last-28-day mean.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls while WORKPLACES rises in the same week (observed t-0w: TRANSIT -24.0, WORKPLACES -18.4)
evidence_refs: fact:at t-0w TRANSIT fell 2.0 points while WORKPLACES rose 1.6 points
failure_condition: In tightening-restriction weeks where TRANSIT falls and WORKPLACES rises, RETAIL_REC exceeds its prior 28-day mean over the following two weeks.
